subtitle: REAL TOWNS / SHORTENED ROADS
name: Verona and the plain to Oppeano
description: Verona from the Adige loop to Borgo Roma, San Giovanni Lupatoto and Oppeano at real scale, joined by their real main roads, shortened so neighbouring towns are a few minutes apart. It is to meet the Lower Veronese plain north of Bovolone (#112).
